archetypes.label: Public humiliation
prompts: a person is publicly shamed, humiliated or mocked in front of everyone
someone is insulted or disrespected before a crowd or family

archetypes.label: Betrayal reveal
prompts: a fiancé, spouse or lover is caught betraying someone with another person
a shocking betrayal or infidelity is suddenly revealed

archetypes.label: Slap / physical shock
prompts: a slap across the face, a strike, a sudden act of violence or assault
a person hits or strikes another in a confrontation

archetypes.label: Secret exposed
prompts: a hidden secret, letter, evidence or truth is exposed and discovered
someone uncovers proof of a crime, a poisoning or a conspiracy

archetypes.label: Confession / forbidden love
prompts: a passionate confession of love or desire against family or society
two people share a charged moment of desire, a kiss or a vow

archetypes.label: Threat / mortal danger
prompts: someone is threatened with death, poison, a weapon or imprisonment
a vulnerable person is in grave physical danger

archetypes.label: Power reversal
prompts: the lowly underdog is suddenly revealed to hold power, status or identity
a beggar or nobody turns out to be a duke, duchess, heir or queen

archetypes.label: Shocking line
prompts: a devastating verbal blow, a cruel verdict like you are worthless or get out
a single sentence lands like a bombshell
